items.title: A finite type module flat over the base and finitely presented over a scheme theoretically dense open is finitely presented
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a finite type module which is flat over the base and finitely presented over a retrocompact scheme theoretically dense open is finitely presented on the nose (statement lines 2942-2958, tag 081N). The proof is a genuine construction: after going affine and expressing the dense open by finitely many principal opens, it builds a finitely presented model of the module that agrees with it on those opens and at a chosen prime, uses openness of flatness to make the model flat on a neighbourhood, and then reads off from an injective comparison square that the module itself becomes finitely presented there. The model construction and the comparison square are the substance, so the claim is H2.
